verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical uniform shrinks of the square into 300x250. Nothing was rearranged for the shorter format. The can now butts against or crops at the bottom edge, while the original left a margin there. 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' and the 'SOLSTICE' label shrink to an illegible few pixels, and the quote mark sits in a cramped top-left area with dead space below the text. A's logo keeps the original's mixed block sizes slightly better. B's logo blocks look evened out and run together, so A wins narrowly.
